regexes.period:
[\.\?!]             # a potential sentence ending
        (?=(?P<after_tok>
            (?:[)\";}\]\*:@\'\({\[!\?])              # either other punctuation
            |
            \s+(?P<next_tok>\S+)     # or whitespace and some other token
        ))
